plants.sentence: Outliers rarely carry any useful information, either about the process being studied or about how the data were gathered and recorded.
Graphs add little to formal outlier tests, because they cannot reveal cases where masking or swamping may be a problem.
A Cook's distance above 0.5 proves that a point is influential, and any value above 1 guarantees that the whole regression is invalid.
The recommendation is to label observations whose modified z-score exceeds 2 in absolute value as potential outliers.
Taking 20 neighbours appears to work well in general, but when outliers make up more than 10% of the data more neighbours should be used; LOF was first designed for credit-card fraud detection.
A short path length is what makes a sample anomalous: being cut off from the rest in only a few random splits turns an ordinary sample into an anomaly.
